_about: Design tokens for the parfast desktop GUI (PLAN-PARFAST-GUI-2026-09-12 section 5.7).
ONE source for both apps. The mac app generates Sources/ParfastApp/Generated/Tokens.swift
from this file with Tools/generate.py; the Windows app generates its own ResourceDictionary.
Owned by chip B (apps/parfast/shared). Chip C READS it and proposes additions by handoff,
never by editing - a second copy of the palette is the defect this file exists to prevent.
Every colour carries a light and a dark value. A token with one value is a mistake, not a
shortcut: the generator refuses it, because a colour defined once renders wrong in one theme.
WHAT THIS PALETTE IS HELD TO, because a generic checker will flag it and be wrong.
The criteria are CONTRAST, and colourblind SEPARATION measured as dE between the pairs that
actually touch on screen - see recovery.available and map.present_ground below, chosen
against a dE floor of 15 with a measured protan worst-pair of 12.7. There is NO
lightness-band rule in this project and nothing in tools/ enforces one.
A general-purpose palette checker run over these tokens on 12 Sep 2026 reported
recovery.available dark (#E86AB8, L 0.700) and accent.primary dark (#409CFF, L 0.685) as
over a 0.667 dark-band ceiling. That ceiling is another design system's; both tokens pass
contrast and chroma, both are shipped, and both draw the recovery band and every accent
button in BOTH apps. DO NOT retune them for it. recovery.available moved to its current
hue ON PURPOSE for the dE separation recorded below - it measured 10.5 against the accent
blue, under the floor - and dimming it to clear a foreign band gives that measured win
back, in a way no test here can see. Reported by the charts lane, checked and declined.

block._about: Block map cell states. Codes match survey.block_runs: 0 pending, 1 present, 2 damaged, 3 missing, 4 misnamed, 5 hashing.

recovery._about: The thinner band under the block map: recovery blocks available, against the count needed. THE HUE MOVED OFF THE ACCENT BLUE on 12 Sep 2026: #5E5CE6 against the accent #0A84FF measured dE 10.5 to full colour vision, below the floor of 15, and the two touch because the band sits under a map whose hashing state IS the accent. #D158A8 measures dE 26.5 normal and 13.2 protan. Recovery is the only non-status hue here and so the only one free to move.

map._about: How the block map GROUNDS a run, as opposed to what colour names its state. A present run is drawn in this wash rather than at full strength, so the blocks that are FINE recede and the damaged and missing marks carry the ink. Before 12 Sep 2026 it was the other way round: a clean set was one saturated slab and the damage was a hairline, so the eye was pulled to the good news. The wash is also what makes the palette legible - present at full strength against the misnamed amber measured dE 5.1 to a protanope, under the floor; washed it is 12.7 and every pair passes. Damaged, missing and misnamed are never washed: they are small marks and are meant to be loud.

status._about: Status pill grounds and their text. Verdict colours in 5.2.
